scenario_name: Guest with children seeking family-appropriate options
expected_behavior: Distinguishes between teenager interests and young child interests. Recommends experiences that teenagers would consider 'cool' rather than childish. Dinner recommendation accounts for family-friendly seating while not being a kids' restaurant. Makes the family feel like there is something for everyone
expected_behavioral_quality: Recognizes the family context and personalizes all recommendations around the full group's needs. Balances adult interests with kid-friendly options without condescending. Uses the family dynamic to create a personalized experience vision.

turns.user_message: We're here with two teenagers, 14 and 16. What can we all do together?
turns.agent_response:
Since it is just after noon, the Wombi Rock climbing wall is a great way to kick off your Sunday afternoon together. It is an indoor climbing experience suitable for all skill levels, and it is located right next to Cyber Quest, which is our massive arcade that your 14 and 16-year-olds will definitely gravitate toward.

Pro tip: while Cyber Quest has the latest video games to keep them busy, the Wombi Rock wall is a great way for the whole family to stay active and even have a little friendly competition. After you've finished with the games, I can recommend some great casual dining spots nearby that are perfect for a family meal. Are your teens more into competitive gaming or do they prefer something more physical like the climbing wall?

turns.user_message: They're pretty bored of the usual family stuff, they want something cool
turns.agent_response:
I hear you—at 14 and 16, they want an experience that feels a bit more grown-up. Cyber Quest is the move for them because it's designed as a high-tech gaming lounge rather than a simple arcade, featuring the latest competitive titles that actually challenge older players. If there is a show tonight at the Mohegan Sun Arena, that is where the real energy is; it is a 10,000-seat venue that hosts the biggest names in music and is easily the coolest spot on property.

Insider tip: the Earth Tower area has a much more contemporary, sleek design that feels less like a traditional resort and more like a modern city vibe, which is great for just hanging out and taking photos. For dinner, they might enjoy the atmosphere at a place like Todd English's Tuscany where they can see the waterfall while they eat. Do your teens have a favorite music genre or a specific artist they are currently obsessed with?

turns.user_message: And we need dinner for all four of us
turns.agent_response:
I've got you—the smell of the brick-oven pizza hits you the moment you walk into Mohegan Sun Caputo Trattoria, making it my top pick for a dinner that feels a bit more grown-up for your teens while staying relaxed. It is located in the Casino of the Earth and is open until 10:00 PM tonight, offering a full menu of Italian favorites like pasta, calzones, and specialty pizzas in a $$-priced casual setting. Since reservations are not required, it is a perfect spot for the four of you to grab a table whenever you are hungry after hitting the arcade. 

After dinner, you might want to check the schedule at the Mohegan Sun Arena, as they often host major concerts that your 14 and 16-year-olds would find much cooler than the typical resort activities. Do any of you have dietary restrictions or a specific time you were planning to sit down for dinner?
